name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest pharma company and a global specialty/generics player. Q2 FY27 sales Rs16,199 cr (+11.9% YoY), OPM ~29%, but PAT Rs1,995 cr (-36% YoY) after one-time charges linked to the ~$12bn acquisition of Organon (shareholders approved 2026-07-24; closing guided for Q4 FY27). Mix: India branded formulations ~32%, US ~26% ($455m in Q2, falling), emerging markets ~20%, rest of world and API ~22% (model knowledge/approx). Global specialty (Ilumya, Winlevi, Cequa, Leqselvi) is the growth engine though Ilumya slowed. Near debt-free before the deal; P/E 35.6; promoter holding 52.68% after the Valia family was reclassified as public.

revenue_mix.segment: Rest of world, API and other

exposures.mechanism: US ~26% of sales ($455m/qtr x Rs94.5 = Rs4,300 cr of Rs16,199 cr), emerging markets ~20%, RoW ~10%; exports ~ 55% of revenue, USD costs ~ 15% => net USD long ~40% of revenue. +3% => +1.2% of revenue / 29% margin = +4.1% EBITDA; hedging + Organon USD liabilities after close (natural hedge) => persistence 0.4, EV/MCap 1.03 => +1.7, shaded +1.5. Pack has no significant USD/INR link.

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 16,199 cr, OPM 29%, PAT 1,995 cr; P/E 35.6; mcap Rs4.39 lakh cr

exposures.mechanism: +10pp tariff on Indian pharma exports. US 100% tariff effective 2026-09-29 with exemption for select specialty drugs/ingredients (29 Sep). Sun US sales ~26% of revenue; assume 40% of that is exposed (generics + non-exempt), 50% absorbed: 10pp x 0.4 x 0.5 x 26% = 0.5% of revenue => -1.8% EBITDA at 29% margin, persistence 0.6 => -1.1; adjust for tail of broader (200% generics noted by TOI 2026-07-22) => -2.0. Coverage of Sun's specific SKUs not verified.

evidence.note: 100% US pharma tariff effective 2026-09-29; select Indian specialty drugs/ingredients exempt (Hindu, Mint, BS)

exposures.mechanism: +1 = stricter enforcement (warning letters/import alerts). Sun's Halol and other sites have a history of OAI status (model knowledge; current status not verified). A new import alert on a site producing ~8% of US sales => revenue -2% at 50% margin => EBITDA -3.4%, persistence 0.6 => ~-2.

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 16,199 cr, OPM 29%, PAT 1,995 cr; P/E 35.6; mcap Rs4.39 lakh cr

exposures.mechanism: +5pp faster annual price erosion in US generics. US generics ~ 45% of US sales (~12% of group revenue); 5% revenue loss on that = -0.6% of group revenue at ~100% flow-through => -2.1% EBITDA at 29%; persistence 0.7 => -1.5. Q2 US formulation sales fell to $455m (Upstox 2026-10-30).

evidence.note: Management admits Ilumya US slowdown, keeps FY27 guidance, Organon on track for Q4 FY27 close (Business Upturn)

exposures.mechanism: Specialty (Ilumya, Winlevi, Cequa, Leqselvi) and generics sales depend on US health spending and payer behaviour, little cyclicality: +1pp US growth => ~+0.3% revenue; mostly a valuation sentiment link. Ilumya slowdown acknowledged by management (2026-10-30).

evidence.note: Management admits Ilumya US slowdown, keeps FY27 guidance, Organon on track for Q4 FY27 close (Business Upturn)

exposures.mechanism: Raw & packing material ~ 25% of sales (model knowledge), of which APIs/intermediates/solvents ~ 40% track chemical feedstock; +10% => costs +1.0% of sales => EBITDA -3.4%; 70% passed via mix/price lag, persistence 0.3 => -0.8. Pack Brent +0.37 (t +1.0) is of opposite sign: ignore (insignificant).

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 16,199 cr, OPM 29%, PAT 1,995 cr; P/E 35.6; mcap Rs4.39 lakh cr

exposures.mechanism: Organon deal funding: Sun is raising ~Rs10,000 cr rupee debt to refinance an acquisition loan; Organon carries ~$8-9bn of existing USD debt (model knowledge; not verified), part floating. +25bp on ~$4bn floating = $10m = Rs95 cr/yr = 0.9% of TTM profit; persistence 0.9 => -0.8. Applies after the Q4 FY27 closing; low confidence.

evidence.note: ET: Rs10,000 cr to part-finance/refinance Organon acquisition loan; board earlier considered Rs15,000 cr NCD (2026-10-07)
